NOTIFICATIONS
Tax Due Dates:
Monday May 11th, 2026
Monday; November 10th, 2026
Treasurer’s Office will be OPEN 8:30-4:15
Ways to pay your taxes:
Treasurer’s office at the courthouse
M, T, Th, F 8:30-4:15pm
Drop box outside of courthouse. Place payment in envelope with tax coupon, name, phone number and parcel number
Friendship State Bank- Rising Sun location only
Must have tax payment coupon with you.
Online: PayGov
Look up by name, parcel number or address. Please have your bill ready so necessary information can be found.
Mail to Ohio County Treasurer,
PO Box. 187, Rising Sun, IN 47040
Has to be postmarked before due date, anything postmarked after due date will be subject to late fees.
